Illustration. Another car, earlier in April (from 17.4 s)
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: 17.0 to 17.2 s the creek car drifts out at the left edge. At 17.4 s cut to a flooded residential street: a beige single-story house, a tree and a green street sign behind a narrow band of brown floodwater in which a white car with a roof pod sits with water to its lower wheels. The bottom half of the frame is an empty pale paved foreground. Disclosure changes to Another car, earlier in April. A dark blob sits at the right edge of the water. Caption appears at 17.6 s over the water/pavement boundary just under the car.
